bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears made a notable roster move ahead of their season opener, agreeing to acquire a 2027 fifth-round pick and defensive back Clark Phillips III in a trade with the Atlanta Falcons in exchange for defensive lineman Gervon Dexter Sr., pending physicals. Meanwhile, head coach Ben Johnson gave quarterback Caleb Williams a strong endorsement heading into Week 1 against Carolina, praising him for how seriously he approaches his job and saying he's locked in and "only concerned about doing his job at a high level."

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions placed running back Isiah Pacheco on injured reserve as part of a flurry of roster moves ahead of the regular season, while also finalizing their practice squad by signing players like Luke Altmyer and Tom Kennedy. Pacheco will be eligible to be activated off IR ahead of Detroit's Week 5 matchup against Arizona , leaving the team to explore other options at running back in the interim.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The biggest story surrounding the Packers is the fallout from running back Josh Jacobs being sidelined, as with Josh Jacobs sidelined indefinitely after landing on the Commissioner's Exempt List, the Green Bay Packers suddenly face a major void in the backfield. The NFL's decision to put running back Josh Jacobs on paid leave has opened a big door for MarShawn Lloyd in Green Bay , while GM Brian Gutekunst noted the team will "be prepared either way" heading into the season opener.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings signed veteran linebacker Kyle Van Noy to their practice squad after he agreed to a deal following a visit with the team. The Vikings picked up one of the top veteran free agents still on the market this week when they signed linebacker Kyle Van Noy to their practice squad.
